newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to announce Oct-Dec GDP data by March 19-EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan to announce Oct-Dec GDP data by March 19-EPA.

text.p: Japan is likely to announce its gross domestic product (GDP) data for the October to December period by March 19 at the latest, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Vice Minister Shimpei Nukaya said on Friday.
"Last year, we announced it on March 20, but we hope to announce it earlier than that. Since March 20 is a national holiday it would mean by March 19 at the latest," Nukaya told a news conference.
The spring equinox falls on March 20 this year.
